import inspect, io, json, textwrap, unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from aetp.core.commands import CommandHandler
from aetp.storage.sqlite_store import SQLiteStore
from tests.m0.test_command_boundary import CommandBoundaryTests

mutants = [
    ('actor_binding', CommandHandler, 'handle',
     'if command.actor_id != authenticated_actor_id:', 'if False:',
     'test_actor_mismatch_cannot_reserve_legitimate_command_id'),
    ('expected_revision', CommandHandler, '_evaluate',
     'if command.expected_revision != snapshot.revision:', 'if False:',
     'test_expected_revision_conflict_is_rejected_without_domain_effect'),
    ('target_validation', CommandHandler, '_evaluate',
     'if command.target_id is None:', 'if False:',
     'test_invalid_target_is_rejected_and_audited'),
    ('premature_commit_before_event_batch', SQLiteStore, 'append_events',
     'connection = self._ensure_open()\n        try:',
     'connection = self._ensure_open()\n        connection.commit()\n        try:',
     'test_top_level_event_failure_rolls_back_command_and_events'),
]
results = []
for name, owner, method_name, old, new, test_name in mutants:
    original = getattr(owner, method_name)
    method_source = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(original))
    # Dedenting reduces the indentation of the multi-line marker equally.
    old, new = old.replace('\n        ', '\n    '), new.replace('\n        ', '\n    ')
    assert old in method_source, name
    mutated = method_source.replace(old, new)
    namespace = dict(original.__globals__)
    exec(compile(mutated, '<mutation:' + name + '>', 'exec'), namespace)
    test = CommandBoundaryTests(test_name)
    test.setUp()  # Real valid bootstrap is deliberately outside the mutation.
    test.setUp = lambda: None
    stream = io.StringIO()
    with patch.object(owner, method_name, namespace[method_name]):
        outcome = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2).run(test)
    killed = len(outcome.failures) > 0 and not outcome.errors and outcome.testsRun == 1
    results.append({'mutation': name, 'target_test': test_name,
                    'tests_run': outcome.testsRun, 'failures': len(outcome.failures),
                    'errors': len(outcome.errors), 'killed': killed,
                    'raw_output': stream.getvalue()})
print(json.dumps({'mutations': results, 'all_killed': all(r['killed'] for r in results)}, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(r['killed'] for r in results) else 1)
